_about: What the narrator says in the café, as small conversations.
pages: shown one after another; the player presses Enter to turn the page (or it turns by itself after a while).
A page can be one text in quotes, or a list of texts in [ ]: then one is picked at random each time.
choices: 2 to 5 answers. 'do' is what happens: "order" opens the drinks menu, "order_suggestion" serves the suggested drink; leave it out for nothing.
ignore: which choice happens if the player doesn't answer (1 for the first). A narrator question waits question_seconds (content/pacing.json).
Things in {curly braces} are filled in by the game: {drink} is the drink in your cup, {suggestion} is another drink served right now, {favourite} is the drink you order most.
arrive: the drink offer after the welcome (content/narrator/welcome.json) and any away note. arrive_favourite is used instead about half the time once you have a favourite that's being served.
cup_kept: said instead of the drink offer when you come back soon enough to find your drink still on the table.
When a cup is empty, the game picks one of the conversations whose name starts with cup_empty, never the same one twice in a row. Add more by giving them names like cup_empty_something.
Keep each page short: about 3 lines of 46 letters at most.
